Description []

Metro Line is an east-west oriented express line of Peckern Transit in Los Sengas, and runs between Festival and Flask. Subsequent development will see this line providing direct services with Yowah Line.

This line is represented by light blue on the Route Map, and is Line Number 4.

History[]

Kasukano Train Railway Era (New Peckern Express)[]

  • January 22 2017: Plans for this line surfaced.
  • April 8 2017: The section between New Phantasm and Grand Squirrel began services.
  • April 11 2017: The section between Grand Squirrel and Metropolis began services.

Peckern Transit Era (New Peckern Express)[]

  • May 1 2017: Kasukano Train Railway shuts down, and this line is taken over by Los Sengas Government.
  • May 6 2017: Peckern Transit is established and takes over this line.
  • June 4 2018: This line became a part of the Co-Op Railway.
  • December 21 2018: A player connected tracks between Metropolis and Cyanland without the operator's permission. However, the tracks have since been demolished by the administrator.

Pelos Metrolink Era[]

  • August 2 2020: After 3 years, this line is officially renamed Pelos Metrolink.
  • August 2020: New Phantasm Station has been renamed Cylupus Valley Station and was rebuilt. As a result, the destination of Metro Line has been changed to Kanjono de Maho Station (Subsequently Renamed Woyi Gap Station).

Metro Line Era[]

  • September 21 2023: After Peckern Metro is renamed Peckern Transit, this line is renamed Metro Line to allude to the theme of "Bustling City", as well as the name of Yowah Line with which it provides Through Service.

Districts Served[]

  • Festival
  • Peckern
  • West Metropolis Archipelago (Passes Through)
  • Downtown
  • Katadelphia
  • Flask

Line Characteristics[]

  • This line is one of the two lines that passes through West Metropolis Archipelago without any stations in the area (The other line being Alpha Line), and is also the only line that provides direct access between Peckern and Downtown.
  • The Grand Squirrel-Metropolis CHT between Grand Squirrel and Metropolis is currently the longest underwater tunnel in Los Sengas.

Fun Facts[]

  • The eastbound Platform 1 and westbound Platform 2 of Metropolis Terminal, which are used by this line, are managed by Nazca Railway and constructed by Nazca Railway alongside platforms 33-40 of Metropolis Terminal in the Phase IV expansion while featuring in-fare zone interchange. At the time of construction, this set of platforms were numbered 41 (Eastbound) and 42 (Westbound), but due to the construction of Phase V and The Shuttle platforms 41-48, the platforms are re-numbered.
  • Among all the lines that serve Metropolis Terminal, this line is the only line which is not operated by Nazca Railway. However, the platforms that serve this line have been in use since the Kasukano Train Railway-era when this line was named New Peckern Express.

History[]

  • May 18 2015: This station began services.
  • May 6 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • July 7 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • September 2 2017: Exit F is added to this station.[4]
  • August 28 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]
  • July 28 2023: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.
  • September 7 2023: Exit G is added to this station to connect to Red Stadium Park Station.
  • April 7 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]

Metro Spring Station is a station on East Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 1L (Metro Spring NR Station Stop).

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Inaccessible)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 0.5-1
  • Find the Hot Springs in this station.
  • Look for an area in the Hot Springs where the water level gets significantly deeper.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a lava bucket.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Solo
    • Control
    • Patience

Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Go through three different pools.
  • The Ceiling of the Last Pool guides you at where to make the leap of faith.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a water bucket.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station alludes to Sheung Shui Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.

History[]

  • May 25 2015: This station began services. East Ring Line is established.
  • May 6 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • July 24 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • June 6 2021: Exit B4 is added to this station to connect to Metro Spring NR Station Stop.[6]
  • August 29 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]
  • February 27 2024: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.

Metro Stone Station is a station on West Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu Downtown Loop Line (Metro Stone Station), Creeper Railway MetKing Line (Metro Stone Station) and SLT Line 1L, Line 104 (Metro Stone NR Station Stop).[4]

Station Characteristics[]

  • This station is the first station in Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division) to share structure with a building, namely the NR Metro Stone Rail House.
  • This station was formerly the only station with one platform on West Ring Line.
  • This station is the first station to be inserted between two existing stations (Metropolis and Greenrock Hill) in the Los Sengas Division.
  • This station was formerly the first station to adopt the Tidal Block System. However, since the addition of the Outer Ring Platform, the system has been rendered obsolete and ceased operations.

Fun Facts[]

  • Besides of being the first station to be inserted between two existing stations in Los Sengas Division, this station is also the first station built on West Ring Line in 2016.
  • This station was the first station to adopt the FoxTrac Tidal Block System.
  • This station is built to commemorate the completion of the Upgrading Works of all West Ring Line stations.
  • Exit D of this station is used solely for interchanging with the Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu Downtown Loop Line Station of the same name.
  • While Exit N of Metropolis Terminal is located at just 100 m to the south of this station, walking to the platforms of that station takes about 1 km.

History[]

  • August 27 2016: This station began services for the West Ring Line Inner Ring Direction only.
  • December 10 2016: This station completed replacement of platform signs.[5]
  • May 17 2020: West Ring Line Outer Ring Direction Platforms of this station completed construction. At the same day, West Ring Line Outer Ring Direction began stoppint at this station.
  • May 23 2020: Exit C2 is added to this station.[6]
  • April 18 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]

Metrojoint Island is one of the islands off the coast of Downtown. While this island originally belonged to West Metropolis Archipelago, this island is now in Downtown District.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
  • 3 Facilities
  • 4 Citations and References

Location[]

Metrojoint Island is located to the south of Downtown and was the easternmost point of West Metropolis Archipelago.

Transport[]

Urban Line, Urban Express bridges that connect South Bay Station with TriPaw Station pass over Metrojoint Island, but no stations are set on this island.

Facilities[]

This island has been converted into Terminal Number 7 of Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals, and begun operations on June 24 2016.

Metropolis (Phase III) Stop is a station of SLT Line 1L. It is located at Los Sengas Downtown above Metropolis Terminal Phase III (Near Exits AA1 and AA2). Passengers may also use this stop to go to the Alpha Line, Bravo Line, Charlie Line and Delta Line Platforms of Metropolis Terminal.[2]

title: Metropolis Forest Park
safeHtml:
Metropolis Forest Park is a forest park constructed by Deepond Industry, which is located at No. 15 Temple Street.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Facilities
    • 2.1 North Area (Red)
    • 2.2 West Area (Yellow)
    • 2.3 Central Area (Purple)
    • 2.4 East Area (Green)
    • 2.5 South Area (Blue)
  • 3 Citation and References

History[]

  • July 22 2016: The land at No. 15 Temple Street started bidding.
  • August 1 2016: The land at No. 15 Temple Street was won by Yangdazhi0903, William_SkyWalk, and Chardylee2004.
  • August 5 2016: The commencement of the Metropolis Forest Park was delayed.
  • August 19 2016: The general design plan was released, and the Metropolis Forest Park construction began.
  • September 12 2016: The Los Sengas Government agreed to recruit assistants.
  • September 23 2016: The Metropolis Forest Park recruited staff, and CoreIsHeart, Reaganc86, and TR6156justin were awarded development assistance rights.
  • October 29 2016: The Metropolis Forest Park was completed.

Facilities[]

North Area (Red)[]

  • Children's playground
  • Exits E, F, G, H
  • Management center
  • Public toilets
  • Visitor center
  • Tour guide dispatch center

West Area (Yellow)[]

  • Observation deck
  • Leisure learning pavilion
  • Completion monument
  • Exit C

Central Area (Purple)[]

  • Epiphyllum Lake
  • Basketball court
  • Table tennis court
  • Volleyball court

East Area (Green)[]

  • Green square
  • Urban labyrinth
  • Exit D

South Area (Blue)[]

  • Tree planting education area
  • Fountain of Time
  • Exits A, B

Citation and References[]

Fun Facts[]

  • This page is the 1600th page of this wiki.
  • The building materials and color scheme of this station alludes to Admin Station of Terracept Division.
  • This station is the first station in Los Sengas Division, as well as the first Terminal-class station.
  • This station has the most exits of any NR Station.
  • This station features the most lines of any NR Station.
  • This station is the first station to be built in 2015, as well as the first to expand in 2016, 2017 and 2022.
  • Platforms 49 and 50 of this station were originally numbered Platforms 41 and 42. However, following the dissolution of Kasukano Train Railway (Los Sengas) and the construction of Phase V, there are renumbered Platforms 1, 2 of Peckern Transit to avoid confusion. Then, after the takeover of Peckern Metro by Nazca Railway (Which is subsequently renamed Peckern Transit by NR) and the construction of Phase VII, the platforms are once again renumbered to their current platform numbers.
  • Prior to the Phase VII Expansion, Platforms 49 and 50 (Then Platforms 1 and 2 of Peckern Metro) were only connected to the Phase IV Concourse by a makeshift passageway.
  • After the completion of Phase VI, the platform number of this station has reached 58, but Platforms 49 and 50 remained unused until the numbers were used by Peckern Transit Metro Line.
  • While Platforms 39 and 40 are built as a part of Phase IV and was originally reserved for ARIES Line use, it was ultimately used by Lima Line and became a part of Phase VII.

History[]

  • March 15 2015: This station began operations.
  • March 16 2015: Phase I completed construction for West Ring Line, East Ring Line and Urban Line. West Ring Line is established.
  • April 20 2015: Phase II coPTleted construction for New Edward Line, Stadium Line and Arcgo Line.
  • April 21 2015: New Edward Line and Stadium Line are established.
  • May 1 2015: Arcgo Line is established.
  • May 24 2015: Urban Line is established.
  • May 25 2015: East Ring Line is established.
  • August 8 2015: Original Urban Line platforms 6, 7 are repurposed for Urban Express. Urban Express is established.
  • January 17 2016: Phase III completed construction for Alpha Line, Bravo Line, Charlie Line and Delta Line. Phase I Ground Concourse completed reconstruction.
  • February 24 2016: Exit C is relocated to facilitate the construction of Temple Street South Stop.
  • March 19 2016: Earth Hour is hosted between 20:30 and 21:30.
  • May 4 2016: Urban Line, Urban Express platforms (Platforms 5-8) finished upgrading to the second generation departure routine.
  • May 5 2016: East Ring Line platforms (Platforms 9-12) finished upgrading to the second generation departure routine.
  • May 12 2016: Exits AA1, AA2 began operations to feature interchange with SLT Line 1L Metropolis (Phase III) Stop. On the same day, Alpha Line extends from Katadelphia North Checkpoint to this station.
  • May 16 2016: Delta Line is established.
  • August 7 2016: Project Nazca fourth anniversary activities cause some exits to be closed for 96 hours.
  • August 11 2016: All exits resumed usage.
  • August 27 2016: West Ring Line Platform 2 of this station began passing through Metro Stone Station. (Platform 1 on the same direction remains unchanged until May 2020.)
  • September 8 2016: Bravo Line is established.
  • September 10 2016: Charlie Line is established.
  • November 12 2016: Plans for Phase IV began.
  • February 11 2017: Phase IV completed construction for Origin Line, Fox Line, ARIES Line and Metro Line (Then named New Peckern Express). ARIES Line and Metro Line platforms remain reserved.
  • February 12 2017: Origin Line is established.
  • February 24 2017: Platforms on Phases I and II (Platforms 1-24) completed upgrading to the third generation departure routine.
  • February 27 2017: Parts of West Ring Line signs (Platforms 1-4) completed upgrading.[13]
  • March 10 2017: Fox Line is established.
  • April 11 2017: New Peckern Express began operations.
  • January 19 2018: In-Train Interchange began between Fox Line and Bravo Line for this station.
  • June 5 2018: Phase III signs completed upgrading.
  • August 15 2018: Signs of Phase I and Phase IV completed upgarding.
  • August 16 2018: All signs of this station completed upgrading.
  • September 5 2018: Phase V completed construction for The Shuttle.
  • October 20 2018: Sava Link began operations. The Shuttle is established.
  • June 10 2019: Katadelphia City Center Link began operations.
  • July 2 2019: Media City Link began operations.
  • January 19 2020: The reserved ARIES Line have been repurposed for Lima Line.
  • May 5 2020: Prosand Link began operations.
  • May 8 2020: Midway Island Link began operations.
  • May 11 2020: Old Brightland Link began operations.
  • May 17 2020: As Metro Stone Station have become a two-way station, both Inner Ring Platforms (Platforms 1,2) of West Ring Line now pass through Metro Stone Station. Also, Outer Ring trains from Greenrock Hill Station have to pass through Metro Stone Station before reaching this station.
  • July 22 2020: Urban Line of this station completed Phase II SignPicuture upgrades.[14]
  • August 2 2020: New Peckern Express have officially been renamed Pelos Metrolink, and Platforms 41, 42 of Phase IV have been renumbered Platforms 1, 2 of Peckern Transit.
  • June 6 2021: Exit AB9 and Exits L4, Q9 have been added to Phase V and the Underground Walkway respectively.
  • October 19 2021: The Shuttle section completed Phase II SignPicutre upgrades.[15]
  • October 31 2021: Wui King Link began operations.
  • November 6 2021: Central Numpool Link began operations.
  • November 9 2021: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[16]
  • December 20 2021: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up. (Original Station Souvenirs have been demolished)[17]
  • February 10 2022: Phase VI began extension.
  • February 11 2022: Phase VI completed construction for Pegasus Line and Phoenix Line, with Phoenix Line platforms remaining reserved.
  • February 14 2022: Pegasus Line is established, but Platforms 53 and 54 remain reserved.
  • March 31 2022: Exit K5 is added to the Underground Walkway.[18]
  • May 22 2022: As Pegasus Line extended to Origin Court Station, Platforms 53, 54 began operations. Moreover, Exits V and W are added to the Underground Walkway connecting to Origin Underground Street StarWalkers Architecture Headquarters respectively.[19]
  • July 19 2022: Phoenix Line signage is added to Phase VI Platforms 55 to 58, but Phoenix Line is not yet in use.[20]
  • July 24 2022: Phoenix Line is established, but Platforms 57 and 58 remain reserved.
  • March 30 2023: As Phoenix Line extended to Memorial Park Station, Platforms 57, 58 began operations.
  • July 26 2023: Exit N5 of the Underground Walkway completed exit naming.
  • September 21 2023: Pelos Metrolink is renamed Metro Line.
  • February 29 2024: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • August 18 2024: Phase VII began extension.
  • August 20 2024: Phase VII completed construction for Lima Line.[21][22]
  • August 23 2024: Lima Line extends from Kaling Channel Station to this station.
  • April 21 2024: The Station Icon of this Station has been modified.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Colors of the Zones in this Underground Walkway pay tribute to the Underground Walkway System in East Tsim Sha Tsui Station of the Mass Transit Railway System in Hong Kong with regards that both Underground Walkway Zones have Red, Yellow and Green Zones. However, due to the number of exits in this Underground Walkway System, the Blue Zone is added in addition to the three colors. It is also likely that the Blue Zone is added to pay tribute to the fact that East Tsim Sha Tsui Station was formerly served by East Rail Line, which also uses a blue color scheme.
  • Exit F1 originally leads to the Terminal Park. However, in order to leave room for the Season 3 List of Stations, it has been relocated.

    • Depot Stop

Middle Island Station is a station on Stadium Line and Fox Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Middle Island. Passengers may also use this station to change to Middle Island Light Rail Blue Line, Yellow Line Hub Station and Blue Line Car Park Stop. Alternatively, passengers may also use Middle Island Light Rail to access Southern Loop (Middle Island Station).

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Inaccessible)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 5
  • While one player is enough, it is easier if two players are there.
  • Pass through a set of two doors from the tunnel between the east and west of Middle Island
  • A very quick reaction time is needed.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a beacon.

Fun Facts[]

  • Before the completion of Edward Island Checkpoint, this station was the most structurally complex station in Los Sengas Division.
  • This station features In-Train Interchange between Fox Line and Bravo Line, the first pair of veloducts to ever do so. Passengers can choose routes from this station.
  • This station is the first station within the Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme to feature "The Cuisine" upon its completion.

History[]

  • June 25 2015: This station began services alongside Stadium Line.
  • November 18 2015: Exit A of this station became bi-directional.[5]
  • May 19 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[6]
  • March 10 2017: Fox Line extends from Metropolis Terminal to this station. Fox Line is established.
  • January 17 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[7]
  • January 19 2018: In-Train Interchange began between Fox Line and Bravo Line for this station.
  • October 12 2018: Services for Fox Line are suspended due to external structure appearing at the Fox Line section between Wativer Station and this station.[8]
  • March 2 2020: Due to historical reasons, services for Stadium Line are suspended. However, operations for Fox Line remain as normal.[9][10][11]
  • July 25 2022: All exits of this station are named.[12]
  • November 4 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[13]
  • March 2 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[14]

Midway Island, abbreviated as MIS, is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. This island is an artificial island, and is built specifically for Midway Island Link of The Shuttle of Nazca Railway.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Railway
    • 2.2 Maritime
  • 3 Facilities
  • 4 Citations and References

Location[]

Midway Island is located to the west of Tye Island, the northwest of Midway Island and the southwest of Rollhill Island.

Transport[]

Railway[]

This island features Midway Island Link of The Shuttle. As a result, this island is home to Midway Island Node.

Maritime[]

This island is highly dependent on ferries in terms of travelling to other islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. As a result, two street terminals are built in each direction of the island.

Facilities[]

  • Nazca Railway Midway Island Node
  • Midway Island Park

Travel Information[]

Passengers can travel from the following nodes to The Shuttle platforms, and vice versa:

Platform Destination Origin
1 Wui King Node Metropolis Terminal
2 Metropolis Terminal Wui King Node
3 Sava Node Central Numpool Station, Old Brightland Station
4 Central Numpool Station, Old Brightland Station Sava Node

Fun Facts[]

  • This Node is built entirely on an artificial island.
  • This station is the last station to be built in West Metropolis Archipelago territory.

History[]

  • May 8 2020: This station began services alongside Metropolis Link.
  • May 9 2020: Sava Link began operations.
  • October 19 2021: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]
  • October 31 2022: Wui King Link began operations.
  • November 6 2022: Central Numpool Link and Old Brightland Link began operations.

Description []

Mike Line is one of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs between Intus Aquilo and Snowty.

This line is represented by Cyan on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number M.

History[]

  • S3E19: Intus Aquilo - Quinty
  • S4E8: Intus Aquilo - Winter Point

Extend Eastwards from Quinty Station to Winter Point Gateway. Completed

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Feathered Waystation.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Particles and Pinnacles".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Feathered Waystation 03:39
Vanguard of the North 02:58

Fun Facts[]

  • The platform of this station has curved ends.
  • The Aerial Platform Gates of this station were not installed until the Upgrading Works were conducted at this station. In other words, this station was the first Station in Los Sengas Division to be built without Platform Gates.
  • This station is the first station to feature vertical line direction and "next three station" signs, and is one of the only two stations in Los Sengas Division to have such a feature.[2]

History[]

  • September 1 2015: This station began services.
  • June 27 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • June 12 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • June 28 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.
  • May 28 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]

Milky Realm Station is a station on Cometsilk Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Prymea. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 2601 (Milky Realm Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the completion station of Cometsilk Line.
  • This Station is one of the few stations that use End Stone Bricks in Nazca Railway.[2] The different colored materials in this station corresponds to the following:
    • Blue Wool and Purple Wool: Cometsilk Line and its theme of Comets in Outer Space. The English Name of this station also corresponds to the Milky Way.
    • Black Wool: Dark Outer Space
    • End Stone Bricks: Used as per the request of the Developer of Starshore at the time of this station's construction.
  • The design of this station corresponds to Blossom Ages Station of Wanderer Line due to the mid-sized nature of the Stations.[3]
  • At the time of the Construction of this Station, it was located at Starshore. However, following the establishment of Prymea as District Number 26 on May 4, Starshore was merged by Prymea and no longer exists. Moreover, due to Prymea redevelopment, the Exits have been reconstructed.
  • After the reconstruction of the Exits, this station is now located under a large roundabout in a fashion similar to Firewood Point Station and Lens Station.

History[]

  • January 28 2022: This Station began services.[4] Cometsilk Line completed construction.
  • June 4 2023: The Exits of this station completed reconstruction.

Description[]

Minecraft Line is one of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along TriPaw and Jupiter.

This route is represented by Light Gray Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 14.

Currently, this route is 16.25 km long, with a total of 10 stations.

title: Miner Bay Depot
safeHtml:
Miner Bay Depot is one of the depots of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It is located at Miner Bay of Tripaw Peninsula. This Depot provides services for West Ring Line, Expo Line, Urban Line, Urban Express, Luxter Line, Kinight Line, Minecraft Line, Ingress Line, Abyss Line, Interisland Line, Gondola Line, Stadow Line, Charlie Line and Golf Line. This depot was formerly the largest depot in Nazca Railway, but was later taken over by the Vector Bay Depot of the East Ring Line. This depot can store up to 60 trains, featuring 30 sidings, ten 204 m long, ten 408 m long and ten 612 m long.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Depot Structure
    • 2.1 Stabling Sidings
    • 2.2 Depot Platforms
    • 2.3 Maintenance Pit
    • 2.4 Loading Sidings
    • 2.5 Connecting Tracks
  • 3 Fun Facts
  • 4 Gallery
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

Miner Bay Depot is located to the south of Miner North Station and the north of Tai Wan Peninsula Station.

Depot Structure[]

Stabling Sidings[]

  • Two Sets of Outer Sidings
  • Each outer siding has ten siding tracks.
  • One set of Central Sidings that has ten siding tracks.
  • Two Sets of Inner Sidings
  • Each inner siding has ten siding tracks.
  • Depot Platforms and Maintenance Pits.
  • The Following Sidings are not connected to the southward tracks:
    • Coast Sidings: Features a total of ten sidings.
    • Bay Sidings
    • Loading Sidings

Depot Platforms[]

  • A pair of Standard Length (204 m) Island Platforms.
  • Does not feature Platform Screen Doors.

Maintenance Pit[]

Loading Sidings[]

  • This is where new trains in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division are loaded. Operates in a similar fashion to Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals.

Connecting Tracks[]

The Depot has two sets of tracks connecting to the railway network, one to the north and one to the south:

  • North Entrance: Directly connected to Miner North Station Platforms 2, 3 for convenience of train services.
  • South Entrance: Feature Sidings connected to West Ring Line tracks. In turn, the main tracks are connected to the shared Minecraft Line, Charlie Line tracks.

Fun Facts[]

  • This depot is currently the third largest depot in Nazca Railway, and is currently the main operations center in Los Sengas Division.
  • This depot expanded after the completion of Minecraft Line, Charlie Line Tai Wan Peninsula Station.

Fun Facts[]

  • One of the players in this server (Kata Ho) had once mispronounced the name of this station as "Mining Nerf Station". That nickname has become the nickname of this station ever since.
  • This station is the permanent Down Direction terminus of Minecraft Line.
  • This station is the first station to ever adopt the Aerial Platform Screen Doors in Los Sengas Division.
  • After the Pegasus Line expansion, Exits A and B of this station could be accessed from both the West Ring Line, Minecraft Line concourse and the Pegasus Line concourse. However, despite this, the exits were not split into different letters (Exits A1, A2 etc.). This meant that this station has the first instance in Nazca Railway of one single exit having two access points.

  • June 25 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • September 11 2016: Minecraft Line is established.
  • June 12 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • March 6 2022: This station began expansion of the Pegasus Line part.
  • March 7 2022: The Pegasus Line part of this station completed expansion.
  • March 8 2022: Pegasus Line extends from Central Numpool Station to this station.
  • April 6 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

Fun Facts[]

  • This is the Station where Akashi Line changes back to left-hand traffic rule after passing Seraphynx Station. From this station, Akashi Line will travel at the left side of the track. This is so that Akashi Line would have enough space to descend to Mei Fwong Station for same-direction, cross-platform interchanges.
  • Besides of changing back to left-hand traffic, two other reasons were attributed to Akashi Line having such a high attitude of tracks at Y=88, such as having existing roads around the vicinity, and the necessity to pass over Phantasia Metro OasisPaw Line tracks.[2]
  • The name of this station is proposed by the developer of TriPaw instead of the Railway builder himself.

History[]
